Under Attack? Talk to Us

We're hiring

1,2,3 - as simple as that

We aren’t one of those firms that never respond to applicants. We are committed to responding to all our applicants, and to keep you informed at every stage of our hiring process.

Simple Steps

  1. Submit your CV to careers@profero.io. Don’t forget to include:
    • Any references that might help learn about your unique skills. Please send blogs, reports, certifications, links to your GitHub or LinkedIn pages, any details about community involvement.
    • Please describe why you feel remote work is a good fit for you (we know it’s not for everyone).
  2. If your application progresses, we will reach out to schedule a short interview call to get to know you better.
  3. You’ll have a technical interview for 60-90 minutes on Zoom to better understand your technical fit for the role.

That’s it.

If we determine you’re a good fit for our team, we’ll schedule a 30-minute meeting to extend you an offer.
